source_pages: printed p.49 and p.51 / PDF 51 and 53 (subset: p.50 and p.52 not extracted), read from 110-dpi renders 2026-09-26
extraction_note: Six positions: p.49 whole but for BK0100, p.51 whole. NOT extracted: p.50 (door for interior drawer, P-One and XL waste) and p.52 (oven base H.60 in two versions, corner base - corners wait on Elda Q7b). Prices not held here. page_observations: The page banner names three collections - Maxima, Intarsio, Tangram - the printed confirmation that Tangram's straight runs are these modules.
Hob flame (legend printed p.19) on d.62 and d.67 of every door and drawer position, never on d.35; not on the laundry basket at all.

base_pull_out_door.description: Base unit with pull-out door - 1 door, 1 soft-close pull-out door (BL0400 with bread bag on the right), no Push-pull device
base_pull_out_door.notes: Read 2026-09-26 from the printed page and its render. Depth letters on this family's OWN page: BK = d.35, BL = d.62, BM = d.67 (not carried from H.78). LEFT OUT: BK0100, the d.35 row. It prints NO hung glyph and no hob flame, while the d.62 rows print both; the registry holds 'wall_hung' per type, so holding BK0100 here would state a hung version the page does not offer. It waits for a per-depth reading. BL0300 and BL0400 are the same size and differ only in the bread bag, as at H.78.

front_layout.note: One full-height front carried by a pull-out mechanism (see printed p.512), not a swinging leaf. Slab geometry is that of a single door; the opening SYMBOL is deliberately not drawn yet - a swing V would be a lie and the pull-out travel of this mechanism is not in the catalog. Drawing rule owed in docs/Drawing_Spec_v0.1.md.

base_pull_out_door.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-09-26 on the 110-dpi render of printed p.49 / p.51: the 'Hung version' glyph (legend printed p.19) is printed beside every depth band this type holds.

base_laundry_basket.description: Base unit with laundry basket - 1 bottom-hung door, 1 laundry bag, no Push-pull device
base_laundry_basket.notes: Read 2026-09-26 from the printed page and its render. Depth letters on this family's OWN page: BK = d.35, BL = d.62, BM = d.67 (not carried from H.78). Hung glyph on both depths; NO hob flame on either - recorded by leaving hob_provisions_depths_mm out, as at H.78.

front_layout.note: One full-height front hinged along its BOTTOM edge. Per docs/Drawing_Spec_v0.1.md the elevation symbol is the inverted V - base on the hinge axis, apex at the opening edge - and the plan shows the leaf fallen to horizontal, projecting forward by the front height. Not rendered yet: 70_symbols.rb draws a single leaf only when a hinge_side is given, so nothing is drawn rather than something wrong.
